title: METEO
summary: Live weather for anywhere on Earth, set in a 3D sky that rains, snows, storms and clears with the real forecast.
overview: METEO was my first Next.js project, rebuilt from scratch on Next.js 16. A three.js sky behind the app renders the real weather: drifting cloud banks, rain from drizzle to downpour slanted by the actual wind, sleet, hail, snow, fog, stars and lightning. Over it sit clean black-and-white cards for a 24-hour curve, a 10-day outlook, wind, sun, UV, air quality, humidity, pressure, moon and an animated rain radar. It runs on free, keyless data from Open-Meteo and RainViewer.
highlights: 3D weather backdrop in three.js: clouds, rain by intensity, sleet, hail, snow, fog, stars and lightning, all moved by the real wind.
First-visit splash that draws the logo, then a staggered entrance with a temperature count-up.
⌘K city search, one-tap geolocation, °C/°F and a 'surprise me' tour of extreme climates.
Animated RainViewer radar that follows the selected place, plus per-place Open Graph share cards.
